name: command-help
title: Per-command help pages (civ <cmd> help and -h/--help)
description: Every subcommand gets a curated built-in help page via both 'civ <cmd> help' and -h/--help: usage with positional args, command flags with legal values, global flags, and examples, printed to stdout with exit 0; replaces the Go default stderr flag dump
creator: zz
